name: DeployMicrosoftFabricItems
description: Deploys Microsoft Fabric workspace items using fabric-cicd Python library.
author: Chantified Lens
helpMarkDown: Use this task to deploy Microsoft Fabric workspace items using fabric-cicd Python library.

inputs.name: authType
inputs.label: Authentication Type
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the authentication method to use for deploying Microsoft Fabric items.

inputs.name: azureSubscription
inputs.label: Azure subscription (service connection)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional. If provided, credentials are taken from the service connection.

inputs.name: azureClientId
inputs.label: Azure Service Principal client id
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure Service Principal client id. Required if client secret is provided.

inputs.name: azureClientSecret
inputs.label: Azure Service Principal client secret
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure Service Principal client secret. Required if client id is provided.

inputs.name: azureTenantId
inputs.label: Azure Tenant id
inputs.helpMarkDown: Azure Tenant id is required if client id and secret are provided.

inputs.name: environmentName
inputs.label: Target environment name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the target environment in the Microsoft Fabric workspace.

inputs.name: includeConfig
inputs.label: Include config file
inputs.helpMarkDown: Include the configuration file in the deployment.

inputs.name: configFilePath
inputs.label: Config file path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the configuration file in source repository. Relative to repository directory. Example: './workspace/config.yml'

inputs.name: workspaceId
inputs.label: Workspace Id
inputs.helpMarkDown: Id of the Microsoft Fabric workspace to deploy to if no config file specified.

inputs.name: repositoryDirectory
inputs.label: Repository directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Location of the repository directory. For example, '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/fabric-cicd-sample/workspace' in Release Pipelines and '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/workspace' in YAML Pipelines. The task will look for Microsoft Fabric items to deploy in this directory.

inputs.name: itemsInScope
inputs.label: Items in scope
inputs.helpMarkDown: List of items to deploy. If empty, all items will be deployed. Example: 'dataflows,dashboards'

inputs.name: fabricCicdVersion
inputs.label: fabric-cicd version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version of the fabric-cicd Python library to use.
